- **Nvidia** (fiscal year ended Jan 26, 2025): operating income of about $81.45B on revenue of about $130.50B gives an operating margin of about 62.4%.
- **Microsoft** (fiscal year ended June 30, 2025): operating income of about $128.53B on revenue of about $281.72B gives an operating margin of about 45.6%.

The gap is 62.42% − 45.62% ≈ 16.8 percentage points.
